messages.subject: Interpreting Factor Scores
parts:
Hi,

I have used Lavaan to model a fisheries system. The model is properly specified and I have been able to fit the model without problems. The model has a one latent variable which I would like to estimate and hopefully also get an error estimate for. I have been able to use the predict function and it has produced what I understand are similar to factor scores.

I have two questions:

1) What is the proper way to interpret these factor scores? Can I interpret the units for these scores as standard deviations from the mean?

2) Is there any way to calculate an error value for these scores?

I am new to structural equation modeling and would be very grateful if someone could point me in the direction of some literature that might help me answer these questions.

Thank you,

Jake Rush
